entities.summary: Patrick D'Rozario, CSC is a Bangladeshi prelate of the Catholic Church who was Archbishop of Dhaka from 2012 to 2020. Pope Francis appointed him as a cardinal in 2016. Patrick D'Rozario is the very first Roman Catholic cardinal from Bangladesh. He led other dioceses in Bangladesh from 1995 to 2010.
